question: Through the 73th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992, the government fulfilled the constitutional obligation stated in Article _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**40**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992** fulfilled the constitutional obligation stated in **Article 40**.
 
• This amendment **added a new Part IX to the** Constitution, which is entitled as "**The Panchayats"** and consists of provisions from Articles 243 to 243-O.
 
• It provided a **constitutional status** to the Panchayati Raj institutions for more effective and efficient functioning.
 
• It m**andated the creation of Panchayats at three levels:** village, intermediate, and district levels.
 
• It also **introduced a system of reservations for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and women in the Panchayat bodies.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Feature
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Objective**
 To provide a decentralized form of governance in rural India.
 
 

 **Finance Commission**
 Article 243-I mandates the State to constitute a Finance Commission every five years to review the financial position of Panchayats.
 
 

 **Elections**
 Article 243-K mandates the State Election Commission to conduct all Panchayat elections.
 
 

 **Duration**
 
 
Panchayats have a term of five years from the date of their first meeting.

 
 
 

 **Article 41**
 Directs the state to secure the right to work, education and public assistance in certain cases such as unemployment, old age, sickness and disablement
 
 

 **Article 42**
 Seeks to ensure humane work conditions and provide for maternity relief. 
 
 

 **Article 43**
 The State shall endeavour to secure to all workers a living wage and a decent standard of life.
